Reqpedia Technologies is seeking a Java Full Stack Developer for an onsite opportunity in Minneapolis. The role involves Java full-stack development using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and frontend technologies such as React.js or Angular.
Software Engineer developing Java full-stack applications with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and React or Angular frontends

Requirements:
• Only H1B,US Citizens and Green Card holders will be considered
• 1–5 years of experience in Java Full Stack development
• Strong knowledge of  Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs
• Frontend development experience with  React.js or Angular
• Understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Basic experience or familiarity with  Python
• Knowledge of databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
• Understanding of Microservices and application development concepts
• Familiarity with Git and Agile development practices
